title: 台阶上的箱子  (Left on the Step)

segments.t: It is almost nine in the evening, and the courtyard lanterns glow softly as Qing wraps up her first shift with Chen. Suddenly, the front gate bell rings once in the quiet night. Listen first.
老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
晚上九点？你站这儿，我们一起去开门。
您好？晚上好！院子外头没人啊！
等等，低头看石头台阶上。
又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
欢迎来到小院客栈，小晴。明天不会无聊了。
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
'Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!'
晚上九点？你站这儿，我们一起去开门。
'Nine in the evening? Stay right here; let us go open the gate together.'
您好？晚上好！院子外头没人啊！
'Hello? Good evening! Nobody is outside the courtyard!'
等等，低头看石头台阶上。
'Wait—look down on the stone step.'
又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
'Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?'
看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
'Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!'
那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
'Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?'
看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
'Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.'
我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
'Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.'
到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
'Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!'
为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
'Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?'
欢迎来到小院客栈，小晴。明天不会无聊了。
'Welcome to Courtyard Inn, Qing. Tomorrow will not be boring.'

Teacher Song's suitcase is back, yet the mystery stranger vanished into the night and asked them to guard his bag until Friday. Episode 1 is complete; see you next time for Episode 2.
明天见！
